import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.LineBundleMeromorphic

/-!
# Injectivity of rational coordinates on line bundles

On an integral scheme, sections of a locally trivial line bundle are determined
by their germ at the generic point. On each trivializing chart the claim reduces
to injectivity for regular functions; sheaf separation assembles the local
equalities. This supplies the injective rational-coordinate map used to identify
a line bundle with its local principal lattices in the function field.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite TopologicalSpace

namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme

namespace LineBundle

variable {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X]

/-- A section of a line bundle on an integral scheme is determined by its
germ at the generic point. -/
theorem generic_germ_injective
    (L : X.Modules) (hL : IsLocallyTrivial L)
    (U : X.Opens) (hU : genericPoint X ∈ U) :
    Function.Injective (L.presheaf.germ U (genericPoint X) hU) := by
  intro s t hst
  choose W hxW hW e using hL
  refine TopCat.Sheaf.eq_of_locally_eq'
    (⟨L.presheaf, L.isSheaf⟩ : TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat X)
    (fun x => (W x).ι ''ᵁ ((W x).ι ⁻¹ᵁ U)) U
    (fun x => homOfLE ((W x).ι.image_preimage_le U)) ?_ s t ?_
  · intro x hx
    exact TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mpr
      ⟨x, ⟨x, hxW x⟩, hx, rfl⟩
  · intro x
    let V := (W x).ι ⁻¹ᵁ U
    have hηW : genericPoint X ∈ W x :=
      ((genericPoint_spec X).mem_open_set_iff (W x).isOpen).mpr (by
        exact ⟨x, Set.mem_univ x, hxW x⟩)
    have hηV : (⟨genericPoint X, hηW⟩ : W x) ∈ V := hU
    have hηA : genericPoint X ∈ (W x).ι ''ᵁ V := ⟨_, hηV, rfl⟩
    let e' := (e x).some ≪≫ (Modules.unitRestrictIso (W x).ι).symm
    have he (r : Γ(L, (W x).ι ''ᵁ V)) :
        (genericStalkIsoOfTrivialization L (W x) hηW (e x).some).hom
          (L.presheaf.germ ((W x).ι ''ᵁ V) (genericPoint X) hηA r) =
        X.presheaf.germ ((W x).ι ''ᵁ V) (genericPoint X) hηA
          (e'.hom.app V r) :=
      ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
        (genericStalkIsoOfTrivialization_germ L (W x) hηW (e x).some V hηV) r
    have hcoord := congrArg
      (fun r => (genericStalkIsoOfTrivialization L (W x) hηW (e x).some).hom r) hst
    have hs := L.presheaf.germ_res_apply
      (homOfLE ((W x).ι.image_preimage_le U)) (genericPoint X) hηA s
    have ht := L.presheaf.germ_res_apply
      (homOfLE ((W x).ι.image_preimage_le U)) (genericPoint X) hηA t
    rw [← hs, ← ht, he, he] at hcoord
    have hEq := AlgebraicGeometry.germ_injective_of_isIntegral X
      (genericPoint X) hηA hcoord
    exact (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso (e'.hom.app V)).1 hEq

/-- Restriction to a nonempty open is injective for sections of a line bundle
on an integral scheme. -/
theorem sections_restrict_injective
    (L : X.Modules) (hL : IsLocallyTrivial L)
    {U V : X.Opens} (hVU : V ≤ U) [Nonempty V] :
    Function.Injective (L.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op) := by
  have hηV : genericPoint X ∈ V :=
    ((genericPoint_spec X).mem_open_set_iff V.isOpen).mpr (by
      obtain ⟨x⟩ := ‹Nonempty V›
      exact ⟨x.val, Set.mem_univ _, x.property⟩)
  intro s t hst
  apply generic_germ_injective L hL U (hVU hηV)
  have h := congrArg (fun r => L.presheaf.germ V (genericPoint X) hηV r) hst
  simpa only [L.presheaf.germ_res_apply] using h

/-- Rational coordinates embed the sections of a line bundle into the function
field on every open containing the generic point. -/
theorem rationalSection_injective
    (L : X.Modules) (hL : IsLocallyTrivial L)
    (U : X.Opens) (hU : genericPoint X ∈ U) :
    Function.Injective (rationalSection L hL U hU) := by
  exact (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso (genericStalkIso L hL).hom).1.comp
    (generic_germ_injective L hL U hU)

/-- On a nonempty trivializing open, the image in the function field is
generated by a nonzero rational function. -/
theorem rationalSection_range_isPrincipal_nonzero
    (L : X.Modules) (hL : IsLocallyTrivial L)
    (W : X.Opens) [Nonempty W]
    (e : L.restrict W.ι ≅ SheafOfModules.unit W.toScheme.ringCatSheaf) :
    ∃ q : X.functionField, q ≠ 0 ∧
      LinearMap.range (rationalSectionLinearMap L hL W) =
        Submodule.span Γ(X, W) {q} := by
  let g : Γ(L, W) ≃ₗ[Γ(X, W)] Γ(X, W) :=
    Modules.sectionLinearEquivOfRestrictIso W (e ≪≫ (Modules.unitRestrictIso W.ι).symm)
  let f := rationalSectionLinearMap L hL W
  have hf : Function.Injective f := rationalSection_injective L hL W _
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := rationalSection_range_isPrincipal L hL W e
  refine ⟨q, ?_, hq⟩
  intro hqzero
  have hzero : f (g.symm 1) = 0 := by
    have hmem : f (g.symm 1) ∈ LinearMap.range f := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    rw [hq, hqzero] at hmem
    simpa using hmem
  have hgen : g.symm 1 = 0 := hf (hzero.trans f.map_zero.symm)
  have h10 : (1 : Γ(X, W)) = 0 := by
    simpa using congrArg g hgen
  exact one_ne_zero h10

end LineBundle

end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme
